calls.title: Dan <> Brent (re: review Proof of Value best practices from Statsig and my previous companies etc.)
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies to optimize the Proof of Concept (POC) process, emphasizing the need for structured documentation and automated tracking systems to manage multiple deals effectively. Daniel highlighted the importance of a POC documentation system and the collaboration with Logan, a former solutions engineer, to create a tracker tool for monitoring POC progress. Automated alerts using AI were also considered, though challenges in integration were noted. The conversation then shifted to sales strategies, focusing on increasing deal sizes by moving away from seat-based pricing to usage-based models. The participants agreed on the need for flexibility in territory management and emphasized a shared vision of achieving significant company milestones, including potential exit goals through acquisition or IPO. Overall, the meeting underscored the importance of incremental process improvements and collaboration across teams.
calls.keywords: Proof of Value, Deal Tracking, Pricing Model, Sales Territory, POC Process, Enterprise Sales
calls.action_items:
**Daniel**
Collaborate with Logan to build out and implement the deal tracker tool to monitor project and POC activity after returning from leave in early March (01:20)
Continue refining deal documentation and tracking processes incrementally to ensure smooth adoption by AE team (05:28)
Explore and pilot hybrid pricing models combining seat-based and usage-based metrics to accommodate various customer types (11:07)
Keep channel of communication open with Brent for sharing insights and improvements related to POVs and sales operations (08:48)

**Brent Holloway**
Provide feedback and strategic insights on territory segmentation and average deal size goals to help refine sales focus and quotas (09:30)
Support the initiative of introducing SMB sales reps to optimize pipeline management and improve unit economics for smaller deals (13:32)
Continue liaison with Ryan and internal Growth Book team to avoid duplication of documentation efforts on POV processes (00:29)
